title: provenance
description: One record per imported source, describing the catalog it came from. Tags CDEs/classifications/bundles via SOURCED_FROM relationships and drives per-source_key grouping in the published parquet. Carries license + attribution (FAIR R1.1).

source_key.description: URL-safe key; names the per-source output group in the published catalog.

provenance_name.description: Human-readable source label (the originating catalog's display name; matches cde.cde_source).

status.description: Curation maturity of this source's content (distinct from a CDE's own registration_status). `draft` = preliminary/sample, not for a public release; `released` = curated + license-cleared, publishable; `deprecated` = superseded. Gates public publishing (a later publish step includes only `released` sources).

source_org.description: Upstream steward org this source was fetched from (e.g. NINDS, PhenX), when applicable.

license.description: Redistribution license for this source's content (FAIR R1.1). Required before a source enters the public catalog. SNOMED-derived content is license-restricted; LOINC requires attribution.

attribution.description: Required attribution/citation text surfaced in the published manifest.
